map.实际耗用 = 用量 ÷(1 − 损耗率/100)；单项成本 = 单价 × 实际耗: Actual consumption = amount / (1 - loss rate/100); single-item cost = unit price x actual consumption / 1000 (CNY); unit cost = total cost / output x 1000 (CNY/kg).
map.损耗对单位成本影响: Impact of loss on unit cost
map.损耗率怎么填？: How Do I Fill In the Loss Rate?
map.指加工中不可回收损耗（去皮、蒸发、粘附属），按实测填；0 表示按用量计。: It means unrecoverable loss in processing (peeling, evaporation, adhesion), filled in from measurement; 0 means charging by the amount used.
map.单位成本为何高于总成本/产量？: Why Is Unit Cost Higher Than Total Cost / Output?
map.因损耗使实际耗用 > 配方量，单位成本被放大，更贴近真实成本。: Because losses make actual consumption exceed the recipe amount, which inflates the unit cost and makes it closer to real cost.
